# Kiln deferred NPC body bundle v1

<!-- Generated from schema/npc-bodies.schema.json by kiln_manage::lint::docs (cargo test -p kiln-manage --test lint with KILN_LINT_WRITE=1). Do not edit. -->

Machine-local assets/cooked/npc-bodies.v1.json generated by the cook tools, excluded from mod identity and restored with a failed cook. sourceHash describes authored inputs for cross-machine agreement; output hashes prove local bytes only. Complete is not committed or Ready, and material-block hashes do not prove material publication.

- Files: `**/assets/cooked/npc-bodies.v1.json`
- JSON: comments **not allowed**, trailing commas **not allowed**
- Schema: [`schema/npc-bodies.schema.json`](../../../../schema/npc-bodies.schema.json); rules: [lint.md](../lint.md)

## Top level

| Key | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bodies` | object | yes |  |
| `entries` | array of [entry](#entry) | yes |  |
| `format` | `1` | yes |  |
| `sourceHash` | [hash](#hash) | yes | Source-derived agreement id; never a digest of machine-local cooked outputs. |
| `sources` | array of [dependency](#dependency) | yes | Authored source file SHA-256 values, including material JSON and texture sources even on servers without renderer metadata. Native admission rechecks these files. |

## file

Pattern `^assets/cooked/[^\\]+$`.

Type: string

## hash

Pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$`.

Type: string

## material

One material block, not merely one JSON file. Client admission checks the source hash, a matching successful kiln.vfx mod/name/GUID row (never a replacement), and the served material resource. Servers skip the renderer check.

| Key | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | string | yes |  |
| `guid` | string | yes |  |
| `mod` | string | yes | min length 1 |
| `name` | string | yes | min length 1 |
| `sha256` | [hash](#hash) | yes |  |
